LOCATION: concert hall in the half-second before the downbeat, the whole room leaning into the gap

the doorway a crowded house left open on purpose — the only way through

the low tide that is the only hour you can walk out to the rock
the held breath at the top of the stairs before the word that changes everything

ANTAGONIST: the generator that reads every silence as absence and fills it
the wall of sound with no door cut into it

the gap you can only cross by stopping first

CHARACTER: the singer who knows exactly where to stop and what not to play

the editor who cut the verse that explained too much
the one who kept the ache rare so it would still cut
